title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Publish — payload
description: Turn on (or rotate the parameters of) hidden-vetter admission for one criterion. Every member but criterionId has a default. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

criterionId.description: The Accepts criterion this applies to. It must already ask for vetting.

livePeriods.description: Live vetter class periods, current first (e.g. ["2026-10", "2026-09"]). Defaults to the current month.

liveTokenLabels.description: Live token labels (e.g. ["token/2026-09"]). Defaults to the current month's.

dripPerTick.description: How many attestation tokens a vetter draws per tick. Defaults to three.

tickLength.description: How long one tick of the drip lasts. Defaults to `P3D` when absent.

events.description: Events this community is running, replacing whatever was there. Absent or empty removes every event.

TickLength.title: TickLength
TickLength.description: The length of one tick of the drip, as an ISO 8601 duration in days and/or hours — at least `PT1H`. A label's tick `t` is the window starting `t` tick lengths after the label's start (`vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-tokens`).

eventId.description: The community's name for the gathering. It is the anonymity set for every token spent under this event, so it names something people attend — never one desk or one shift.

startDate.description: First day of the event, inclusive.

endDate.description: Last day of the event, inclusive.

graceDays.description: Days after endDate the label keeps being accepted. Defaults to fourteen.

groupFloor.description: The smallest group this community will open the label for. Defaults to three.

tiers.description: The published menu of rates a vetter may pick from.

approvedBy.description: Who approved the event. Absent means nobody has, and the label is not live whatever else is true.

name.description: How the menu names it: desk, busy-desk.

dripPerTick.description: How many tokens a tick under this tier yields.

approvedBy.description: Who approved the event, or null when nobody has. Recorded in storage only — dropped from the published shape (see published.events).

PublishedEvent.title: PublishedEvent
PublishedEvent.description: The published shape drops approvedBy and graceDays: who approved is the community's own record, and a vetter is told closesAfter when its request is approved rather than being handed the raw grace period here.

StoredConfig.title: StoredConfig
StoredConfig.description: The parameters exactly as the community stores them, including the helper key it never publishes.

suite.description: The blind-signature suite in force, e.g. ps-ddh-bls12381.

hvk.description: The helper verification key, multibase. A public value, published as helperKey.

tvk.description: The token verification key, multibase. Never the same key as hvk.

livePeriods.description: Live vetter class periods, current first, stored as the bare YYYY-MM period.

PublishedConfig.title: PublishedConfig
PublishedConfig.description: The parameters exactly as they now appear in this community's join manifest, under vetting.ext. What an applicant and a vetter read.

helperKey.description: The helper verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for hvk.

tokenKey.description: The token verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for tvk.

vetterLabels.description: Class labels published whole, e.g. vetter/2026-09 — a request names one of these, not the bare period.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Hidden — Publish — response payload

criterionId.description: The criterion that now accepts a hidden proof.

requirementsDigest.description: The criterion's requirementsDigest after the change. It moves, because the digest covers the published parameters — an applicant mid-application is told its requirements changed, which is the honest answer. Null only when the criterion's manifest entry carries none.
